nodes.label: BaseMetadataProvider
nodes.rationale: Abstract base class for all external media service integrations. Supplies pre-configured ky HTTP client, urlBase support, 10s timeout, JSON Accept header, and error logging hooks. Keeps auth boilerplate out of individual provider methods.

nodes.label: PlexService
nodes.rationale: Plex spans both services/ and providers/ deliberately: PlexService validates Plex auth tokens against plex.tv (used by AuthService during login), while PlexProvider fetches libraries and media items from locally configured Plex Media Server.

nodes.label: AppError Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: All application errors extend AppError. isOperational flag separates expected business errors (true) from programming bugs (false), allowing the global error handler to respond differently.

nodes.label: defineRoute
nodes.rationale: Connects Zod schemas to handler logic. Validates params/body/query, throws ValidationError on failure, wraps success result in {status:'ok',data:T}, and forwards errors to error middleware. Single place for logging and metrics.

nodes.label: Awilix DI Container
nodes.rationale: Services registered with .scoped() (new instance per HTTP request) or .singleton() (shared). Handler factories receive injected services via cradle destructuring — no manual req.scope.resolve() needed inside handlers.

nodes.label: theme.ts — Three-Layer Theme System
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for all colours. Layer 1: primitive palette (hex values). Layer 2: semantic tokens mapping intent to palette. Layer 3: Tailwind themeColors with CSS vars for automatic dark-mode switching. Never write hex outside palette.

nodes.label: API Response Envelope
nodes.rationale: Every API endpoint returns {status:'ok',data:T} or {status:'error',error:{type,message,errors?}}. Frontends switch on status and the machine-readable type field, not HTTP status codes, since multiple error kinds can share the same HTTP code.

nodes.label: Badge Logo
nodes.summary: Brand badge/logo for Maintainarr (now Warden). Shows a teal/dark-teal gear icon containing a network/hub graph node motif (central node with 6 satellite nodes), set against a dark navy/charcoal square background. The product name 'Maintainarr' is displayed in teal text below the gear. A small decorative star/sparkle appears in the bottom-right corner. Color palette: dark navy background, teal/cyan gradient gear, white node dots, teal typography. Style is flat/semi-skeuomorphic, suitable for app store badges, GitHub repo headers, or sidebar branding.
